name: CKCSS
generationRules: Prefer semantic HTML and native accessibility attributes.
Use --ck- semantic tokens for theme overrides.
Prefer native HTML interactions; Enhance JavaScript is optional.

requiredAccessibility: aria-invalid with visible error text when invalid
aria-describedby when help or error text exists

states: th[aria-sort=ascending|descending] renders the sort indicator; a plain th[aria-sort] shows the neutral affordance

media.note: Pair with ck-grid + ck-grid--auto-fit (set --ck-grid-min: 10rem) for the surrounding grid; no dedicated grid class is needed.

compositionPatterns.note: These are deliberately NOT separate classes — compose the primitives above to avoid duplicating layout that already exists.
compositionPatterns.adminLayout: ck-sidebar (+ ck-sidebar--end to flip sides) already is a sidebar+main content layout.
compositionPatterns.toolbar: ck-cluster ck-cluster--spread already is a space-between, wrapping row for search/filter/action controls.
compositionPatterns.statCard: ck-card > ck-card__body > ck-stat already is a bordered stat tile with value/label/delta.
